# Advanced Mermaid 0.2.1 interaction checks

Open this note in Live Preview. Use the first diagram for the editor controls
and the second for rendered zoom and pan. Source-only mode displays Markdown.

## Editor transitions and keyboard

1. Select **Live Editor**, select the source, and press Enter several times.
   The surrounding note should stay in place while the source caret remains
   visible. Tab indents the line/selection; Shift+Tab outdents.
2. Select **Close Editor**. **Rendered View** should be selected and source should
   stay collapsed. Reopen, then check the same result with Esc.
3. Select **Static Editor**. The original fence should be editable. Select
   **Rendered View** to collapse it. Move into an ordinary paragraph; the mode
   should also reflect that neither editor is active.
4. With Focused block activation enabled, explicitly close the editor and
   confirm that it does not immediately reopen. Try both fences and a split
   pane. Keep invalid CSS protected when switching modes.

```pele
flowchart LR
  A[Source] --> B[Preview]
  B --> C[Saved note]
```

An ordinary paragraph provides a cursor position outside the fence.

## Rendered navigation

In rendered Live Preview and Reading view, all three navigation buttons should
be visible even on this small diagram. Select **Zoom In**, drag the diagram to
pan, and select **Reset Zoom**. Keyboard users can focus the SVG and use arrow
keys after zooming. Export should retain the complete diagram.

```pele
flowchart LR
  Small --> Diagram
```

## Editor style settings

Open **Settings → Advanced Mermaid → Live editor settings → Editor style settings**.

- Check the source size input, slider, and reset, including a previous saved size.
- Edit source text/background in both themes. Reset source text color to restore
  syntax highlighting. The gutter should use the source background.
- Check button size and each active/inactive/Close/Export font/background pair.
  Export and the other buttons should have the same text size.
- Check invalid color/size input, independent light/dark resets, live changes,
  and persistence after plugin reload. Diagram labels should retain their styles.
- Narrow the pane and check wrapping. Current status and Renderer details should
  use the smaller secondary text size.
